description: Use this when you need one inbox's address, display name, metadata, status, client_id, screening, send_mode, or plus-address format and you already have its id, username, or email. Read-only; requires auth. Inputs: inbox_id (required; inbox id, username, or email). Returns the inbox {id, username, email, display_name, created_at, require_sender_auth, labels, expires_at, status, paused_at, metadata, client_id, screening, send_mode, signature, alias_format}. alias_format is username+{tag}@domain. Mail to that plus address is stored in this inbox. It is not a separate inbox. A reply still sends From the inbox address. signature is {text, html} or null. send_mode is direct or approval. Another account's inbox returns HTTP 404 inbox_not_found. Guide: https://cooperemail.com/docs/aliases.

inbox_id.description: Inbox id (inb_…), username, or full email address owned by this key

name: cooper_get_inbox

alias_format.description: Read-only plus-address pattern username+{tag}@domain. Mail to that address is stored in this inbox.

client_id.description: Caller idempotency key stored with the object, or null.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 time the object was created.

email.description: Full email address of the inbox.

expires_at.description: ISO-8601 time the object expires, or null for no expiry.

id.description: Inbox id (inb_…). Pass it as inbox_id to other tools.

metadata.description: Caller key-value data stored on the object.

paused_at.description: ISO-8601 time the inbox was paused, or null.

require_sender_auth.description: When true, only mail that passes DMARC/DKIM can create an owner task.

screening.description: Inbound screening mode: off, observe, or hold.

send_mode.description: direct sends immediately. approval turns sends into drafts a verified owner approves.

signature.description: Signature {text, html} added to sends, or null.

title: Get one inbox
